notes.title: Why are you working if you can use the power of AUTOMATION?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/3c61457899b270f8a6cd4aa7df3ca24f2e189cd4.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, Friends![/b]

Today we’re thrilled to bring you two significant changes to No Place Like Home! The first one is that we’ve implemented controller support - a feature we know you’ve been eagerly waiting for, so now you can lie down on the couch and enjoy the game like never before! We hope your comfortable couch sessions with a gamepad in hand will be tons of fun!

The second addition is one that’s considerably bigger gameplay-wise and will let you play the game in a completely different style by letting some processes run hands-free while you attend to different quests or matters. We’re adding automated bots!

[b]But before we jump into the details, we’d like to let you know that our newest game - Captain Pawsome - launches today in Early Access! [/b]

Captain Pawsome is a cozy 2D fishing game where you play as the titular captain. You’ll manage your own shop and upgrade your ship as you journey across the ocean, cleaning up the environment and catching tens of unique types of fish. If you’d like to set sail on a relaxing adventure with your own feline captain, be sure to check Captain Pawsome out!

[previewyoutube=LUlrsAthM7U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551000/Captain_Pawsome/

Now, back to the automation - right now we’re adding 5 new stations, each with its own robot, that will perform a specific task related to your farmstead:

[h2]THE PLANTER ROBOT[/h2]

This little fella searches for free plots of land and plants the seeds, if the robot has them in its inventory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/d74350de82a9e7abaef904d9ea0a561932ebb541.gif[/img]

[h2]THE IRRIGATOR ROBOT[/h2]

Automatically water the plants (or any plot that is not watered) using this useful blue liquid-dispenser:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/c533c7871bfdb9998514a6680c9ebfdbaef556c9.gif[/img]

[h2]THE HARVESTING ROBOT[/h2]

This particularly useful four-legged green robot will take care of harvesting the crops and tree fruits for you, and even bring them back to put in the chest:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/77983eec6e464bcdad2c53b07980929e28c6ac7f.gif[/img]

[h2]THE ANIMAL HANDLER ROBOT[/h2]

This one is an animal lover! The Animal Handler, as the name suggests, collects animal products and brings them back to your chests (remember that you still have to pet your animals):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/a0c066a77a99893b71ab0f3f0befba55f9fb8b0b.gif[/img]

[h2]THE RESUPPLIER ROBOT[/h2]

This practical mechanical buddy resupplies feeders and water in the animal buildings. Be aware, though, that it requires pet food in its inventory to operate feeders (it can’t create it on its own, it’s just a robot):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/32e05b1643fd4a0ac044cab915baaf5a97e4306c.gif[/img]

You can use these bots to fully automate your farming experience. Of course, you would still have to insert the seeds or animal food inside the robots, but as we already mentioned - that means you can go and do other stuff! Pretty amazing, don’t you think?

And that's all for today! We really hope that you will enjoy these changes! Feel free to share your thoughts and feedback with us. Have fun!

notes.title: Big new content update + Japanese language! + NPLH is out on Switch!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello friends![/h3]

We have some exciting news to share with you today! Not one, not two, but three announcements! There’s lots to share, so without further ado, let’s jump straight into it. Enjoy!

But before we go there here is a quick off-topic announcement we hope you will enjoy!

[h1]Pan'orama is OUT NOW![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/

Our newest game, Pan'orama, just released! It's a puzzle game in which you create beautiful landscapes with hex-shaped tiles, complete objectives to earn points and discover unique structures with abilities that shape the environment around them!

The game is available now at a [b]special release discount[/b]! For a limited time, you can get your hands on it at [b]20% off[/b]! Head on over to the game’s Steam page and treat yourself and grab it now!

[b]Here's the launch trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=CpCI5R-97Ag;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What you can you do in Pan'orama:[/b]
[list]
[*] relax and unwind while creating beautiful worlds out of hex-shaped tiles
[*] sculpt unique biomes by placing tiles of the same type next to each other
[*] place tiles in specific places around objectives to get extra points
[*] test your skills and creativity while aiming for a high score
[*] unleash your imagination in creative mode with a variety of creator tools
[*] interact with cute animals that pop up all around
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/a1e54d182d821ba75585ff88a905a1245479d643.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/7b104c09b5492445b860f6eed7c2c47bd4274caf.png[/img]

Go ahead and dive into it, relax and unleash your creativity like never before and build the most stunning Pan’oramas ever!
Ok lets go back to major No Place Like Home announcements: 

[h1]No Place Like Home is out on Nintendo Switch![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/a34b4ef061e3a87afb9f63a8d8075675d51e8f81.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new patch, we have some more exciting news to share with you! No Place Like Home is now available on the Nintendo Switch thanks to our partnership with Merge Games! 

Not only that, you can purchase it in both digital and physical formats.[b] The digital version is already available, so you can grab it from the eShop[/b]! And if you prefer to have a physical copy to add to your collection, you can pre-order it today and it will be shipped to you as soon as it's released (planned release is summer 2023). So whether you're at home or on the go, you can now enjoy all the fun and creativity of No Place Like Home on your Switch!

[h1]Japanese language[/h1]
皆さん、こんにちは！

Starting today, a new language option has been added to the game - the Japanese language! If you notice any errors or mistranslations, please let us know, we'll be happy to verify and correct any errors.

よろしくお願いします。

[h1]Game content updates[/h1]
From adorable flower pots with animals peeking out, to a new language option, to a giant pig zeppelin, this update has it all! Here's what's been added in today's patch:

[h3][b]The media set[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/87cd67405565679a85baab185e7cc8e16f06605c.jpg[/img]
Perfect for binge-watching all your favorite shows (if your imagination allows it) while pretending you're not avoiding your responsibilities in the post apocalyptic world.

[h3][b]New wallpapers[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/63ab80ee242374843c1d19efc43308f381208f06.png[/img]
There are lots of stylish new patterns to choose from, including simple designs, subtle florals, and even some cute animal prints. Whether you want to make a statement or keep it understated, there's a wallpaper to suit every taste.

[h3][b]Giant duck[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/9b67b59db718fb9f3cfb081779fe469db6b26fdd.jpg[/img]
But wait, there's more and it’s pretty quack-tastic. We’ve added a giant duck for all of you oversized, cute animal fans! That's right, now you can have a rubber friend that's almost as big as your house. It's up to you to find it and feed it as much rubber as you can!

[h3][b]Pig zeppeling and new cap[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/1bdfaa5e2ff146124594a74d5aa597ad96123076.jpg[/img]
For those of you who prefer your decor to be a bit more airborne, we've added a pig-zeppelin. That's right, a floating pig! There’s also a new, oinktastic pig-zeppelin-themed cap for your animals to wear while they attend their funky parties. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/de183fb9ac3864cc223b04dafdeed93a45046000.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Swing[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/da675aab77dd42a478b440c806988009f8ae2682.gif[/img]
LNext one is a swing decor item. Now you can pretend you're a carefree child again, letting your pet chicken swing back and forth.

[h3][b]Chickilla[/b][/h3]
For final one we have added giant Chickilla! Travel the world, find secret statues and summon the biggest chicken in the world!
To avoid spoiling too much here is a in engine preview ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/07e4dc8081478d6041f3b0ddc55d47ccc8c978e5.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy these new additions and can't wait to see how you incorporate them into your homes.

[h1]Final battle fixed[/h1]
We have also fixed final battle, now our final boss is more challenging and requires some skill and reasonable time to be defeated. We hope that you will enjoy this change!

[h1]Fishing patch status update[/h1]
We would also like to extend our sincerest apologies to all of you awaiting the fishing patch. We know that it's been a long time coming, and we understand how frustrating it can be to wait for something you're excited about. We want to assure you that we haven't forgotten about the fishing patch, and it's still in the works. However, we want to make sure that it's perfect before we release it to you. The fishing patch is going to include an entirely new area, activity, and a bunch of fishes for you to catch. This means that there's a lot of work that needs to be done, but we promise it will be worth the wait. Again, sorry for the delay!

[h1]Controller support[/h1]
Last but definitively not least the topic of controller support. There is no other way to put it rather than we are sorry of how this turned out. 
This was our first digital project ever and we realized rather too late that we are not fully aware what full controller support means.
At the moment you can play and finish the game with controller and this is what we thought was fine. 
Based on your feedback and negative reviews we can see its not good enough and we need to make it better. We just need to know what exactly are your expectations?
Is alternative version of tutorial for controller and key bindings for controller are good enough or do you need some more? Please let us know!

Thanks for reading! We hope you enjoy the new additions to the game and as always, please feel free to share your thoughts and feedback with us. Have fun!

notes.title: New Major Patch is here! New Dungeon Zone, Challenge Mode and a lot more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=X0wuJx9hZpg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Dear friends![/h1]

[h3]New Major Patch is here! Check out New Dungeon Zone, Challenge Mode and a lot of improvements! + small announcement of upcoming projects[/h3]

Finally a new update is here and its a huge one! We are excited to announce a new Dungeon Zone, new Challenge Mode, and lots and lots of improvements to our game. Thank you so much for all your comments and reported bugs and we hope that most of them have been resolved with this patch. We have prepared for you a new trailer with a feature summary as well as a detailed list of changes below. But before we get to the long list of improvements, bug fixes, and, above all, the description of the new mode, we wanted to share some interesting news with you.

Soon we will be launching Early Access of our two new titles that we hope will suit your tastes. We are so excited about them and we hope you will be as well. That of course does not mean that we have stopped working on the next updates and improvements for No Place Like Home and you can expect more updates coming in the future! 
If you like our work we would appreciate if you checked them out and add them to your wishlists!

[h1]Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856030/Fresh_Start_Cleaning_Simulator/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856030/Fresh_Start_Cleaning_Simulator/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856030/Fresh_Start_Cleaning_Simulator/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1856030/header.jpg?t=1659593925[/img][/url]

The first game will surely appeal to those who love cleaning in No Place Like Home as the title draws heavily on [b]power washing[/b] and [b]vacuuming[/b] mechanics. In Fresh Start, you will visit many places from the Icelandic seas, through the Australian plains, to the Japanese gardens and old abandoned Train Station, where you will [b]clean the environment[/b],[b] help distressed animals[/b] while restoring nature and each location to its former glory. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856030/Fresh_Start_Cleaning_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/f72fdf5c7494c79f52d25cc7812769ee68958934.gif[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856030/Fresh_Start_Cleaning_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/4e3f83497ad15cb422bb90272a2acf3592e1d50f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Pan'orama[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1730250/header.jpg?t=1659535263[/img][/url]

[b]Pan'orama[/b] is a relaxing and soothing city builder game where you [b]create amazing landscapes[/b] using different types of tiles, [b]clean trash[/b], complete tasks and most of all [b]keep discovering the secret structures.[/b] Whether you just want to sit, relax and use your imagination to create worlds, follow a story campaign and learn it's secrets or you are looking for challenging puzzles you will find something entertaining for yourself!  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/a5a35e5273bd3387b87dc03e30dff191596854ea.gif[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730250/Panorama/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/4e3f83497ad15cb422bb90272a2acf3592e1d50f.jpg[/img][/url]

That's it for now! Let us know what you think and let's get back to what is most important topic of new Patch.

[h1]NEW IMPROVEMENTS AND CHANGES to No Place Like Home:[/h1]
We did our best to fix all the problems you had with the game and added some features to make the gameplay more rewarding and enjoyable.
These changes apply to the whole game (some of the options are disabled in Challenge Mode)

[h3]Full controllers support[/h3]
We did our best to fix all the problems you had with controllers. We now proudly announce that the game has full controller support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/d89a3ab4aaf3ed839937c945f32752740c0f5183.png[/img]

[h3]Dungeons [/h3]
Explore brand new dungeons full of new enemies (yes, there's something to be afraid of :)), new room layouts where, if you're lucky, you'll find suitcases full of treasures! If you are a risky and explorer, this is definitely something for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/2bc6e4848242acf216e0baea06c940e6e057289f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/c3ec44fd78794fb852a1c6e40b2478eaef8204e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/ebf54d5832a4858a0225ac35d0a8ceba33896ba5.png[/img]

[h3]Dungeons map has been added[/h3]
New dungeons map allows you to navigate through the depths of the undergrounds - but of course in the [b]challenge mode[/b] you can forget about such help :) You have to draw the map in your head.
New Dungeon Zone brings new areas to explore, new puzzles, new shortcuts, new items to find and of course new places to clean for those that still have not got enough ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/d620446720bb913e96f9aaaab681cc5b4dddd05b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/78a03b3ae54380250591e573fe551c8b84ee37ef.png[/img]

[h3]Quest tracking [/h3]
The Big Arrow leads you. Now quests should be more fun to fulfill, and again - forget about such help in the challenge mode :)
Every time you get a quest a compass will point you to the thing you need to find. Check your journal and you should be able to change the quest it currently tracks. There are several quests that are not tracked by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/08a4175de6c954419b6dbcc3131a3845e36cb5ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/ee2d249e882f06b8efb49a6dfa804d297683e7c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Basic enemies attack with gas - no more jumping spiderbots![/h3]
Previous attacks often caused some problems so we have changed them into new more thematic ones!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/1b51fe31ba715df7c7d257c773ff55f34bfdbdb5.gif[/img]

[h3]Roll - a new way of dodging enemies [/h3]
Now you can dodge out of most actions you’re in the middle of. If you’re planning on taking the challenge of the Challenge Mode it’s best you train it, it might be crucial for your survival!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/11590b62b28a2f199970cfc0844a963897c0651f.gif[/img]

[h3]Ellen responsiveness[/h3]
Now it's definitely more responsive to all controls. We heard your comments and decided to spend a lot of time to make controlling our heroine more fun and much less frustrating!

[h3]Option to disable tooltips [/h3]
Some of you didn’t like the tooltips shown in the game. You can now disable them from showing in the game world in the game options (all hint’s will be visible in shops, journal and inventory at all times)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/df6230b927621685beaa5c9d753f84538b58be2a.png[/img]

[h3]Tooltip size change[/h3]
Now they are much smaller. And we hope you will like them as well. We already liked them very much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/731f52e9d9c32c571bf872863a4893ce5abf0b5a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Info about blueprint cost in crafting station & crafting prices in blueprint store [/h3]
Now you can crosscheck how much the item you’re getting the blueprint for is going to cost in the crafting station and vice versa! (might be very useful in Challenge Mode)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/71c02e3f24252bde4b7b63b74cdbcf5bb8498096.jpg[/img]

[h3]Batteries are now a recyclable material[/h3]
Since you can produce batteries in solar power station there might come a moment when you’d have a bit too much of those. No worries, they’re good for recycling!

[h3]Unused and obsolete quest items are available for recycling too! [/h3]
We found a way to free you from the obsolete quest items - now, when the quest is complete, the corresponding quest items display a small recycle icon, indicating that you can recycle them :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/70ecde976e7f8272be121d3d8188003964c45c17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/98c38673968ae1d7a0e9657cbaf35f9c32eccb80.jpg[/img]

[h3]Speed buff from food reworked [/h3]
Have you heard that eating gives you a lot of energy? In No Place Like Home, it works exactly the same. If you take it solidly, your stamina will never end. Well .. almost never. Until you get hungry :)
(unlimited stamina as long as food buff is working)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/96eea0d183438fece69735cb41f0be6364d37d2a.png[/img]

[h3]End game window has been added [/h3]
You have enough? Everything works as it should? The world was saved? Time to leave the planet towards Mars? So let's go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/00c5b6063349c66c9cec59dfedd28377dca4524e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Tutorial popups added[/h3]
Not everything is always as easy as it may seem. And here we come to the rescue. Now, pop-ups with helpful information will accompany you on your way through this post-apocalyptic world.

[h3]New Bathroom and Bedroom furniture and tapestry[/h3]
We know how important the design elements of your sweet nest are for you. That is why we decided to significantly expand the portfolio of available elements and now both bedrooms and bathrooms have gained a lot of new elements that we believe will make you feel "at home";)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/6f4654bc79fc7124b200f8531573aaa30ef24796.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/6b6bf909c15c21edc4ef76b700b4d7167384f184.jpg[/img]

[h3]Optimisation fixes [/h3]
Optimization is always one of the main goals in game development. So this time we are coming with smaller and bigger changes, and one of the important one is an option to turn off the foliage. It will definitely increase your game speed on slower machines. 

[h3]Widescreen support[/h3]
You read well! From now on you can fully enjoy the game even on widescreen monitors. No more clipping or picture in the window. Let the game fill the screen fully.

[h3]Fixed walls in Ellen’s house[/h3]
We have heard about the problems with the walls in your wonderful houses and we have not been deaf to this problem either. From now on, the problem should be completely gone.

[h1]CHALLENGE MODE:[/h1]
It should be much more demanding and should quench the thirst for a harder game for players who enjoy a challenge. Here’s a list of changes that will definitely make your lives harder: 

[h3]New economy - everything is more expensive(CHALLENGE MODE)[/h3]
The game economy had a full overhaul so now you’ll need to make more conscious decisions when deciding what and when to buy. Also, you’ll need all the help you can get, so don’t forget to ask Llamas and Cubebots for help!

[h3]Dungeon’s map is disabled (it’s called Hard Mode for a reason!)(CHALLENGE MODE) [/h3]
Dungeons are back, changed and upgraded, but the map is unavailable underground. Navigation should be a challenge in exchange for more resources and shortcuts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/49966ff3abbce603ee092e461cdf139face43db5.png[/img]

[h3]More enemies, new enemy layout - they are faster and tougher to beat(CHALLENGE MODE)[/h3]
In Challenge Mode all enemies have a tougher skin, faster movement and their setup is different than usual. Be ready and prepare yourself some boosters in the form of healing meals.

[h3]Stun bot (bzzt!) - there’s a new bot on the block(CHALLENGE MODE) [/h3]
It doesn’t do much damage (at first) but if it zaps you, the stun might leave you vulnerable for attacks from other enemies. Stay grounded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/f28fe474d5c042c34fe840750bbcf827862e8a95.png[/img]

[h3]Stun mechanics have been reworked (CHALLENGE MODE)[/h3]
Now stunning is available only with water hose

[h3]You can sleep only between 6:00 PM and 7:00 AM (CHALLENGE MODE) [/h3]
No time to sleep during the day…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/4e7da8fbf07f42dc8c646b567b8dc283395ecac4.png[/img]

[h3]You lose HP if you don’t sleep at night (12-5 AM)(CHALLENGE MODE) [/h3]
But you need some sleep eventually, everybody needs rest… 

[h3]You don’t lose HP if you drink coffee(CHALLENGE MODE) [/h3]

In Challenge Mode you’ll be able to find Coffee seeds, grow your own coffee beans, grind them yourself in a special coffee grinder and have your very own Coffee that will allow you to stay up all night with no health penalty!
First night window will explain all the coffee and sleep mechanics to you - it pops up one time only, at 10:00 AM on the first night (only available in Challenge Mode - don't worry about your casual modes;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/87ca592dbf4a384768799222071018543f8c5026.gif[/img] 

[h3]Superchicken (CHALLENGE MODE)[/h3]
It's damage and behavior has been changed so that it allows for gathering supplies from destroyed cubes - in Challenge Mode every resource counts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/8f89740cb2b1d45a3df80ca6b98325b6891d7804.gif[/img]

[h3]Superchicken counter got added[/h3]
It clearly shows how many shots are left and that water is disabled until all chicken shots are taken. 
One of the birdfeeders is gone from the start of the game, but you can normally buy it’s blueprint and craft it.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/59ada22efa2c2a203892a8ed1f744eda703ca896.png[/img]

notes.title: New Fixes, Balances and Changes!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We're back with the new update and there is even more on the way! We carefully go through all of the messages and topics, where we gather all the feedback you give us, so that we can act upon things that are most important for our players - you!

At the same time, apart from fixing things we come with ideas on how to make the game suited for a broader audience and have a refreshing effect on the day of the final release.

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] Increased stacking amount for trash in inventory from 500 to 2000 (and we will soon increase it to 9999)
[*] Increased stacking amount for other items in inventory from different amounts to 50 (and we plan to increase it to 100)
[*] Now all hats can stack in inventory, so no more space is wasted
[*] Crafting plant field will now properly be pulled towards player and not land on top of the crafting station
[*] Removed the mechanic that restricted planting to Pots and Greenhouses only - now flowers and more advanced crops can be planted in regular plot fields
[*] Added extra information about putting hats on chickens so it's not a mystery anymore
[*] Fixed the "infinite eggs" (and other animal-based products) production
[*] Bigger interaction hitbox for a dog - it's much easier to interact with it
[*] Increased the amount of resources collected by Llamas
[*] Increased the number of available objective items on farm (the amount required by quest unchanged), now it shouldn't be such a problem to find them
[*] Fixed the problem with players getting stuck during Cornelius Disco Ball quest (partially fixed, might still cause some issues)
[*] Fixed missing icon for  the message in a bottle
[*] Moved fast travel entrance closer to the Ellen’s house
[*] Architect’s house location updated (this will be visible on new saves only)
[*] Cornelius should now properly leave after finishing his quests (no more hanging around idly) 
[*] Fixed message in a bottle missing icon and dialogue
[*] Fixed the issue with unintuitive toxic waste piles
[*] Fixed oats for quest so that no one gets stuck on using up quest item to do something else
[*] Interaction is now back as it used to be - to camera-forward based, and not Ellen-forward based
[/list]

[h3]Balance change[/h3] 
This is quite a big change to current economy. For now we decided to make all the costs for blueprints and crafting much lower (but still reasonable). We are looking to hear your feedback about current costs and adjust accordingly if needed. More casual players should feel much more relaxed with new prices and more advance players should still find them meaningful. Let us know what you think once you check them out!

[h3]New Recycler/Jar maker outputs[/h3]
We have made all Recyclers and Jar makers much more efficient. They can now produce much more at once and they only need to work 2 minutes at 1st lvl, 1 minute and 2nd lvl and 0,5 minutes at 3rd level.
We hope that it will make all the wait and progress much more enjoyable now but if you feel you want even better performance just let us know and we will discuss it as well.

[h3]Casual Mode - Adventure Mode - Challenge Mode[/h3]
Thanks to all your feedback we have realized how many different expectations and favorite aspects of game you have. We would love to provide different approaches to game and to accommodate your different playstyles without having too many compromises. We decided few days ago to add Casual Mode to the game that will make everything free and available from the start. It can be played instead of standard Adventure mode and it will be dedicated to people who just want to relax and farm without any challenge. 
Adventure Mode mode will be same as current live version with a bit of challenge and demand from player. 
Third mode we want to add is Challenge Mode that will have more demanding enemies, bigger costs and few more challenges. We hope that this way everyone will find a mode perfect for them and we will not be forced to sacrifice anything. Please note that Challenge mode will be added around 1 month after full release as current focus is on fixing everything and making Adventure and Creative mode as good as we can but its coming.

Thank you for your understanding and continuous support!
We're not stopping to work hard to make this game polished and complete with all the features we have *almost* ready and in store for you. Our intention is to make you feel that No Place Like Home stands up to it's name.

You can expect another update tomorrow with details on what is coming next soon!

notes.title: What's coming next - Post Patch Repair Plan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/fb63a3fcb12873d7484414fc2f6799f32ca3dd4a.jpg[/img]

Hey guys!

Today we wanted to do a short update on post-patch progress and we are extremely grateful for all your feedback.

We are very proud that we managed to roll out that update and that so many of you like new features and changes but unfortunately there were some mistakes that we have made and we need to address them now.

This is our first digital project and we have still a lot to learn but you can be sure that we want to make everything right.

[h3]Save reset[/h3]
First of all we know that game reset should have been better communicated and we apologize for that. 
We hope to not make that mistake in future and that all the upcoming changes to game will make up for it. We will also prepare a creative mode for you that you let you catch up very quickly to where you have left last time. More on that below.

[h3]Beta testing[/h3]
Secondly we should have done more beta testing of a patch and gather more feedback. We were super excited about all upcoming changes and we thought you would love them too. Unfortunately some of things did not live up to your expectations or in some cases we see that you feel that few changes have downgraded the game. We understand your point and we are already discussing possible solutions. 

We have gone through all of your feedback posts and all the bug reports and I am very happy to say that we can fix vast majority of problems.

We have already started working on a lot of issues and you will get a separate update tomorrow with patch notes. For now we wanted to address all the problems asap and present you our solutions. 

Main problems that we have recognized and that we plan to fix in upcoming days are:

[h3]Too expensive recipes:[/h3]
We understand that the game may feel grindy now and we need to make everything cheaper. Our intent was to make trash count more and be useful in crafting but we understand that we have overdone it and it needs to be fixed. For now we will make everything very cheap again and then discuss with you how would you like to have our economy rebalanced. 

[h3]Limits of farming:[/h3]
We have introduced new pot plants and greenhouse that were supposed to be needed for better types of plants. We understand that it may be confusing so this limitation will be removed form the game and you will be able to plant everything anywhere you want. 

[h3]Fast travel system:[/h3]
We understand that you need more fast travel options and we ar working on those, more details coming soon and we will also gather more feedback on your requirements to make sure we do not overdo it.

[h3]Missing Underground:[/h3]
We got a lot of feedback that the undergrounds are too confusing and too complicated so we decided to simplify them. Now a lot of people are missing the “good old” undergrounds and we feel you. 
We need however more feedback to learn what exactly are you missing?
Please post your opinions in this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1472660/discussions/0/3178981911782551421/

[h3]Missing Cube bots [/h3]
We truly did not expect so many people to miss them as they were only a placeholders in game but we are happy to say that with so many popular requests they will be returning to our game in next few weeks 😉

[h3]Missing quest Animals and farm Animals:[/h3]
All animals in the wild will get their own patrol region so you can always find them in specific places and they will no longer walk into inaccessible places. 

[h3]Bug reports:[/h3]
We have recognized a lot of bugs that you have reported and we are working on those. Tomorrow we will post a detailed report and list of what exactly we will be fixing next. 

[h3]Crashes, missing items, loading problems[/h3]
Unfortunately there are still problems with game crashes and vanishing content. We will post tomorrow a dedicated email and instruction on how to send us your save games so we can investigate and fix those issues. 

[h2]Creative Mode:[/h2]
This a a big addition to game that we hope that you will love. We will add a creative mode next to a normal game mode where everything will be free and available from the start including all recipes, crops animals and fast travel options. This is a mode dedicated to people who just want to farm and clean the world without any gates or obstacles. It will take around 1-2 weeks to complete but we hope that it will be a great addition for people who want a full relaxing experience without any limitations.

[h3]What will happen next?[/h3]
1.	Tomorrow we launch a quick fix patch with a patch notes update that will address a lot of current problems. 
2.	On Wednesday 16th we post another update with fixes and more specific plan on fixing next problems.
3.	By Wednesday 23rd we post another patch with fixes and we start discussing all your further requirements on separate discussion topics on forum.

Thank you all for all the feedback, all your posts, comments and discussions and for being with us. We want to make a best game that we can and we couldn't do it without you ;)

chickens and take a good care of them. She has to build them a house, grow food, give them funky

It features New Zone that doubles the size of the game, New Animals, New Crops, New Quests, New Farm Equipement, New NPC and lots of new features such as improved tools, new crafting system, new cooking system, home decorations and much more! \

Thank you very much for your feedback and support. We couldn't ask for a better community!
Most of this update is just a recap of a patch preview from weeks ago so if it sounds familiar it is ;)

No Place Like Home is actually our first digital project. We just wanted to say that we still have tons to learn and mistakes to avoid in the future and we very sorry about any issues and inconvenience that our game may cause you. notes.title: 1st Major Patch Announcement - Mid-April Release Date!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys!
[/h1]
As we are getting close to End of March we wanted to update you on our progress. We have been working very hard on delivering everything that we planned, but we will need 2 extra weeks to make it happen. 

[b]Taking everything into consideration First Major should be released in mid-April.[/b]

Thank you for your patience and we hope you will enjoy it as we have prepared a lot more features and content for you!

We originally planned on releasing 2 new zones with the first Major patch but after all your feedback and suggestions we have decided to postpone the release of one zone in exchange for a major game overhaul.
 
We understand that you were looking for that update and we don’t want to leave you empty-handed and so we are very excited to announce some of the changes and features from the upcoming 1st Major Patch together with the new Lonley Hills zone. 

[h1]Overall system simplification:[/h1]
Based on your feedback we realized that the previous tools system wasn’t clear enough and it caused more confusion than fun. Additionally hitting trash piles with the shovel wasn’t as satisfying as vacuuming and so we decided to make it more pleasant. 
And so Pick Hammer and shovelsaw have been removed! We also removed the ammo system from the game. We found it an unnecessary addition that does not support the main theme of the game.

[h2]3 Simple and Fun Tools[/h2]
What we are left with is 3 simple and fun tools:

[b]Drill- Hit or hold Left Mouse Button
Water hose - Hit or hold Right Mouse Button
Vacuum - Hit or hold Space[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/0b566b61aa5049cec201281e82d1308d02b492cb.png[/img]

[h2]One Drill to clear them all :[/h2]
With all tools converted to one drill, you can now destroy all cubes by either hitting them (as earlier) or with a pleasant continued drilling action. No need to think anymore about which button does what and how to use different tools. All you need now to do is upgrade your drill once you find a cube that can't be destroyed with the current drill level.

Check out new continued drilling action: (yes we still need to work on sound;))
[previewyoutube=l_rzYqVO32k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Watering system Overhaul:[/h2]
The previous version wasn’t clear, precise and satisfying enough and so we decided to completely redo it. 
Now it works like a watering hose and we hope you will love it. Check out how it looks in game!

[previewyoutube=9yMTUdLtQUs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Currency, Crafting and Shop systems![/h2]
We liked the idea of buying new stuff for food and recycled materials but something was always not right. A lot of you also suggested introducing a crafting system that feels more like crafting, less than shopping. We hope you will like the following changes! 

Now we have 2 distinct currencies:

[h3][b]New Blueprint Currencies - [b]Jars and food [/b][/b][/h3]
Jars are new universal currency that replaces previous "Delicious Dishes". You can now turn any of your food with Jar maker into Jars and spend it together with food on new blueprints (crafting recipes). 
[h3]
[b] New Crafting Currencies - Recycled Materials and Resources [/b][/h3] 
Recycled Materials is also new universal currency. You can turn any Trash and Resources into Recycled Materials and spend it together with specific resources on crafting items. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/96cf651c6bd15dfc0e54551aeff03610d4f76277.png[/img]

[h2]New Shop system - Helpful NPC's[/h2] 
We turned all shops into something new – Helpful NPC’s. Now every NPC will be able to teach you new crafting blueprints in exchange for Jars and specific food. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/9860e056f8fe788acb1c684a41a1d68ee9fe880d.png[/img]

[h2]New Crafting System [/h2] 
Once you unlock new blueprints you will be able to craft your items directly at your farm! Your crafting station will tell you who can teach you new recipes (blueprints) and how much materials you will need to craft those items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/0fa2631763b80e45797912aa66a0c82be2bc7c1b.png[/img]

[h2]New Journal [/h2]
We have also introduced new journal to the game that will hold all the info that you need as well as your inventory. You will be able to find there info about quests, guides and map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/8a3adf372f3cecdca0550293f1d997559ec09f6a.png[/img]

[h2]New Jar Maker and Kitchen[/h2]
We understood that the previous kitchen wasn’t very clear and fun system and so we decided to redo it as well.
[h3]New Kitchen[/h3] 
We introduced to game new kitchen system where you will be able to use your produce to cook food and dishes. Those dished will be required to domesticate some animals, they will be useful for quests and learning new recipes as well as making new friends. You will be also able to turn every dish into Jar Food currency and it will be always worth more than individual ingredients so better plan your cooking ahead to make sure you can use up everything you got! Some dishes may even give you extra bonuses.
You will be find new cooking recipes all over the game world, find them in hidden places, get them as rewards or even find secret recipes by experimenting with random ingredients!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/1479d62a5e5b660380723781aa6f5cc0afc89026.png[/img]

[h3]New Jar Marker[/h3] 
New Jar maker is simply new version of old Kitchen where you can turn any food into universal currency. This time you will have full control over what food you want to turn into Jars so no more misclicks and losing important ingredients! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/c83a8fa10759a460d9a6c11ac83eb1f59a72ae2a.png[/img]

[h1]New House Features[/h1]
We are also working on developing more features that will turn that old tree house into your dream home.

[h2]New wallpaper and wall pictures [/h2] With new patch you will be also able to repaint your walls, setup new wallpapers and hand pictures on the walls! No need to live in dirty house anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/46a4dc0b57fd76d24310125691f5075502e52e28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/a9d200b013cda45e3f68c2f00018c41eab85acb3.png[/img]

Also check out this super cute chicken wallpaper and get ready for some more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/eb573562457864137307358df68d02e97b60f19f.png[/img]

[h2]New Rooms[/h2] With new zone and introduction of Architect NPC you will be able to unlock new rooms in the house and renovate them into a cozy home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/11acc0564de557384995807f6940218d714dcc8e.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39143148/cdcd884e3d94a46e689a4b2c78f45a6286b3cdf1.jpg[/img]
Hey guys!

Patch 0.14.82 is live!

Please report any bugs here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1472660/discussions/0/3105765614234988458/]Patch v0.14 is live ! (REPORT BUGS HERE )[/url]

New patch includes:

- Big Optimization update - We divided world into few zones (no loading screens!) and added a lot of LOD's. We got on average 15-20 more FPS and we are still working on further improvements.
- Upgraded Vacuum particles
- Added Key rebinding options
- Added progress bars on stations
- Updated animal behaviors and new animations
- Added Save games in cloud
- Days are now longer
- Added New tag system for items on inventory and shop window
- Improved input (vacuum and tools should not longer get stuck)
- Made Various fixes and upgrades in tutorial
- Created better indication of your home for starting players
- You can now remove old bed once you buy new one
- Few new and upgraded sounds for enemies, trash cubes and water
- More save slots to choose from + save delete warning popup
- Item acquisition popups system - list of the last drops picked up by the player

Bug fixes:
- Many fixes on various decorations
- Fixed bug that crushed game after removing recycler
- Fixed preview colors for few building in building mode
- Fixed info window for building destruction
- Fixed a broken crops perk
- Fixed few (although not all) enemy behavior bugs
- Fixed few places where you could get stuck
- Fixed few sound option issues
- Fixed incorrect loading of large enemies on the map
- Fixes for camera locking on objects
- Fixed multiple problematic spots in environment
- Fixed interaction highlight at "Ultra kitchen"
- Item description fixes and new icon implementation for drill
- Fix for double windows that show up sometimes while going to sleep

What about New tools and crafting system?
Actually we finished working on new tools system but its still needs further testing and we prioritized other tasks ahead of it as, although its not great, it works pretty well at the moment. We plan to post a fully polished version with Major March Patch.
Regarding new crafting after further tests we realized that we cannot implement it without bigger overhaul of current systems and we will start working on it right after next Major Patch.

What about That Major March Patch?
Actually work goes full speed ahead, and it is scheduled for end of March. We already made new NPC, new Animals, new work stations, plants, recipes, we are greatly improving Journal system, we are adding new cooking system with recipes, and new exciting zones to explore and quest! We can’t wait to share them with you!

Do we have to wait another 6 weeks for update?
Actually after reading your feedback we decided to do more smaller patched between major patches and they should go out every 2-3 weeks 😉They should mostly include quality of life improvements and bugs fixes while Major Patches will focus on new content.

What about hotfixes?
We have already recognized few new minor issues and we will post another hotfix update in next few days. You can also report any encountered problems/bug in thread linked above.

Thats it for today, thanks guys and see you soon with next update!
